items.name: image.generate
items.since: Introduced anna-app-runtime v0.4 · current v0.13.0 / dispatcher 0.17.0
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_llm_facade → image provider (DALL·E / SDXL / FLUX / …) → R2
items.summary: Generate `n` images from a text prompt using the host's configured image provider. The host enforces the per-(user, App) `image_grant`, checks plan quota, calls the provider, stores bytes on R2, and returns short-lived presigned URLs. The bundle never sees a provider key, never holds R2 credentials, and never bills directly.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport details (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) are described once in the section overview.

items.signature: anna.image.generate(args: {prompt: string, n?: number, size?: string, reference_image_urls?: string[], quality?: string, resolution?: string, output_format?: string, enable_web_search?: boolean, thinking_level?: string, modelPreferences?: {hints: {name: string}[]}}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{images, model, quota_used, ...}>

params.name: prompt
params.summary: Natural-language description of the image to generate. Trimmed; an empty string after trim is rejected with `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.
notes: Forwarded verbatim to the provider — provider-side safety filters apply.
Provider safety refusals surface as `IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED` (-32115, HTTP 400; `data.stage:'provider'`) since dispatcher 0.29.0 — previously `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`.

params.name: n
params.summary: How many images to generate in this call. Must be a positive integer.
notes: Clamped against `image_grant.maxPerCallGenerate` (default **4**) — exceeding → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST` with `n={n} exceeds per-call cap {max}`.
Independent host hard-cap of **8** lives in the Anna Agent runtime `_MAX_N` for the plugin-side path; the App-side facade enforces only the grant value.
Per-invoke rolling counter (`image_grant.max_images`) is **not** applied to App-side calls — those quotas are scoped to Executa plugin `tool_invoke_id` and not to App sessions.

params.name: size
params.summary: Output dimensions as `WxH`. Default `1024x1024`.
notes: Provider-validated — unsupported aspect ratios surface as `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR` (HTTP 400 underneath, code `-32104` on the legacy HTTP route).

params.name: reference_image_urls
params.summary: Up to 4 reference image URLs the provider may condition on (style transfer / prompt-image blends). Validated by `validate_image_url` (no internal hostnames, no private IPs, no `file://`).
notes: Any failing URL → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST` with `bad ref: <reason>`.
Prefer `image.edit` over `image.generate + reference_image_urls` when you have a single source image — better fidelity, simpler quota accounting.
Text-to-image-only models (e.g. Seedream 5.0 Pro on fal) reject reference images with `APP_INVALID_REQUEST` — the capability guard reads the model's `supports_reference_image` flag.

params.name: quality
params.summary: Rendering quality tier for GPT-Image-family models. Strongly drives per-image cost (e.g. GPT Image 2 at 1024×1024: low $0.006 / medium $0.053 / high $0.211) — billing follows the actually-requested tier.
notes: Validated host-side (`parse_image_options`) — any other value → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.
Models without a quality knob (Nano Banana, Seedream, Qwen, Doubao) silently ignore it; no surcharge is billed.

params.name: resolution
params.summary: Native output resolution tier for Nano-Banana-family models. Billed at 0.75× / 1× / 1.5× / 2× the model's base per-image rate respectively.
notes: Validated host-side — any other value → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.
When omitted the host derives the tier from `size` (max edge ≤512 → 0.5K, ≤1440 → 1K, ≤2880 → 2K, else 4K).
Non-Nano-Banana models ignore this option.

params.name: output_format
params.summary: Encoded output format for fal-hosted models. Falls back to `png` when the routed model does not list the format in its `supported_output_formats`.
notes: No billing impact.

params.name: enable_web_search
params.summary: Ground the generation in live web results (Nano Banana 2 only). Adds a small per-call surcharge (currently $0.015) which is included in the billed quota.
notes: Ignored (and not surcharged) on models without `supports_web_search`.
Must be a boolean — any other type → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.

params.name: thinking_level
params.summary: Reasoning depth before rendering (Nano Banana 2). `high` improves compositional planning and adds a small surcharge (currently $0.002) included in the billed quota.
notes: Validated host-side — any other value → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.

params.name: modelPreferences
params.summary: MCP-shaped request-level model hint. When a hint resolves, it wins over the user's `image_gen` preference for this call; the actually-used model is reported in the response `model` field.
notes: Resolution (`resolve_image_model_hint`): hints tried in order — case-insensitive exact model-name match, then substring — against active `text-to-image` models; plan-gated models outside the user's `allowed_plans` are skipped.
A miss silently falls back to the user preference route (MCP semantics) — never an error.
Non-object value → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.

returns.type: { images: Array<{url, ...}>, model, model_provider, latency_ms, quota_used, ... }
returns.desc:
Schema produced by `executa_image_gate._build_response`. The relevant keys for App authors:
• `images[]` — each `{url}` is a presigned R2 GET, **~30 min TTL** (`R2_TRANSIENT_PRESIGN_EXPIRY = 1800s`). Fetch the bytes or round-trip through `upload.inline`/`upload.negotiate` for durable storage.
• `model`, `model_provider` — provider that fulfilled the request (lets you label the artifact in your UI).
• `quota_used` — `{images_today, images_quota, …}` for the user's plan. Use this to gray out the generate button when the cap is hit instead of letting the user click into a 429.
• `latency_ms` — provider round-trip; not the host wall-clock.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: `image_grant.enabled == false`, `allowGenerate == false`, or the underlying executa row is disabled. Mapped from `APP_ERR_NOT_GRANTED` (-32001) by the dispatcher. HTTP 403 on the legacy `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/generate` route.

errors.name: APP_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Missing/empty `prompt`, non-int `n`, `n <= 0`, `n` over the per-call cap, or a `reference_image_urls` entry failing `validate_image_url`. Mapped from `APP_ERR_INVALID_REQUEST` (-32004).

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: User plan quota exhausted — either the pre-call `check_quota_available` (very small floor of 0.01) or post-call `check_and_consume_quota_with_redis`. Mapped from `APP_ERR_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (-32015). HTTP 429.

errors.name: APP_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: Provider 5xx, safety refusal, upstream timeout, or unsupported size/aspect-ratio. Mapped from `APP_ERR_PROVIDER_ERROR` (-32003). The original gate error message is preserved verbatim.

errors.name: not_implemented
errors.desc: Store does not support `image_generate` (local-dev harness without a facade).

errors.name: IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED
errors.desc: Provider safety / content-policy rejection (since dispatcher 0.29.0; previously `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`). Not billed.

limitations: Returned URLs expire in ~30 minutes. Never persist them as-is; call `upload.inline` (or `upload.negotiate`+`confirm`) to copy the bytes into the App's durable R2 namespace if you need them later.

CSP gotcha: the iframe's `img-src` must allow the host's R2 hostname. Either add `https:` (or the specific R2 domain) to `manifest.ui.csp_overrides.img-src`, or display the image via a same-origin proxy.

Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: if the iframe is in `require-corp` mode, R2 presigned URLs that don't include `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin` will be blocked (`ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOriginAfterDefaultedToSameOriginByCoep`). The default Anna App runtime does **not** set COEP for this reason — only opt in when SharedArrayBuffer is required.

No streaming. Image responses are buffered; a slow provider (DALL·E 3 cold-start, FLUX queue) can take 30-60 s — the SDK default per-call timeout is `DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS_BY_NS.image = 180_000` ms (180 s), override via `opts.timeoutMs`.
Per-invoke rolling quota (`max_images`) used by Executa plugin-side image calls is **not** applied here. Only `image_grant.maxPerCallGenerate` and plan-level quota apply.
Returned `images[].r2_key` can be re-signed for 7 days with `anna.image.resign({r2Keys})` (v0.25.0) — the 30-min URL is no longer the only window.

items.name: image.edit
items.since: Introduced anna-app-runtime v0.4 · current v0.13.0 / dispatcher 0.17.0
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_llm_facade → image provider → R2
items.summary: Mutate an existing image URL using a text prompt; the source image is not modified. Requires a stricter grant (`image_grant.allowEdit = true`) than `image.generate` because edits often imply higher provider cost. Optional `mask_url` enables inpainting where the provider supports it.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport details (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) are described once in the section overview.

items.signature: anna.image.edit(args: {image_url: string, prompt: string, n?: number, size?: string, mask_url?: string, quality?: string, resolution?: string, output_format?: string, modelPreferences?: {hints: {name: string}[]}}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{images, model, ...}>

params.name: image_url
params.summary: The source image to edit. Must pass `validate_image_url` (no internal hostnames, no private IPs, must be `http`/`https`).
notes: Typically the presigned URL returned by a prior `image.generate` (live for ~30 min), or a presigned download URL from `upload.inline`/`upload.confirm`.
If the URL has expired by the time the provider fetches it, the result is `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR` — re-mint the URL via `image.generate` or by re-issuing the upload flow.
Validation failure → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST` with `bad image_url: <reason>`.

params.name: prompt
params.summary: Edit instruction (e.g. 'restyle in cyberpunk aesthetic'). Trimmed; empty → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST`.

params.name: n
params.summary: Number of edited variants. Must be positive.
notes: Clamped against `image_grant.maxPerCallEdit` (default **1**) — usually stricter than the generate cap because edit variants are expensive.
Edit providers often return `n=1` regardless of request; check `out.images.length` rather than assuming.

params.name: size
params.summary: Output dimensions. When omitted the provider preserves the source `image_url` dimensions.
notes: Some providers reject explicit resize on edit — surfaces as `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`.

params.name: mask_url
params.summary: Optional PNG mask URL for inpainting. White pixels = edit, black pixels = preserve.
notes: Validated by `validate_image_url` — failure → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST` with `bad mask_url: <reason>`.

Requires a mask-capable model: Doubao Seedream (volcengine) or a fal model with `supports_mask_editing` (GPT Image 2 — forwarded as `mask_image_url`). Otherwise the gate returns `MASK_UNSUPPORTED` → `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR` (HTTP 400 underneath).
Mask dimensions should match `image_url` dimensions; providers vary on how strictly this is enforced.

params.name: quality / resolution / output_format
params.summary: Same semantics and validation as on `image.generate` — quality tier (GPT-Image family, billed per tier), resolution tier (Nano-Banana family, 0.75×–2× rate), output format. Unsupported models ignore them without surcharge.
notes: `enable_web_search` / `thinking_level` are also accepted and apply to Nano-Banana-family edits (same surcharges as on generate).

params.name: modelPreferences
params.summary: Same MCP-shaped hint as `image.generate`, but resolved against active `image-editing` models (plan-checked). A miss silently falls back to the user's `image_edit` preference.
notes: Hints matching text-to-image-only models are skipped — the fallback route is taken instead of an error.

returns.type: { images: Array<{url, ...}>, model, model_provider, latency_ms, quota_used, ... }
returns.desc: Same shape as `image.generate`. `images[]` URLs are again presigned R2 GETs with **~30 min TTL**. The source `image_url` is **not** modified — edits land in fresh R2 objects.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: `image_grant.enabled == false` OR `allowEdit == false` (default). Mapped from `APP_ERR_NOT_GRANTED` (-32001). HTTP 403.

errors.name: APP_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Missing `image_url`/`prompt`, bad URL via `validate_image_url`, non-int or non-positive `n`, or `n` over the edit per-call cap.

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: User plan quota exhausted.

errors.name: APP_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: Provider 5xx, safety refusal, or `MASK_UNSUPPORTED` / `INVALID_REQUEST` (mapped to HTTP 400 underneath; gate's message is preserved).

errors.name: not_implemented
errors.desc: Store does not support `image_edit`.

errors.name: IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED
errors.desc: Provider safety / content-policy rejection (since dispatcher 0.29.0; previously `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`). Not billed.

limitations: Source URL must be reachable from the provider's network. Internal-only URLs (private R2 bucket without presign, intranet hosts) fail validation or fetch.
Mask support varies per provider. Probe with a small request before exposing a mask UI to the user.
Edit grant defaults to **off**. `image_grant.enabled = true` alone is not enough; the user must also flip `allowEdit` in Anna Admin.
Same URL-expiry, CSP, and COEP caveats as `image.generate`.
Edits do not chain — each call goes back to the provider; there is no server-side artifact graph that would let the host skip a re-fetch of `image_url`.
Returned `images[].r2_key` can be re-signed for 7 days with `anna.image.resign({r2Keys})` (v0.25.0) — the 30-min URL is no longer the only window.

items.name: image.generateAsync
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.image_generate_async → quota hold → anna_media_jobs INSERT (kind:'image') → fal queue (webhook + poller) → R2 exec-images/…
items.summary: Submit an asynchronous text-to-image / reference-image job. Body = `image.generate` body + `clientTag?` / `idempotencyKey?`. The host validates exactly as the sync path, **pre-charges** per-image price × `n`, persists an `anna_media_jobs` row and returns an `ijob_…` handle within ~1s. Progress arrives as `media_job` events (`kind:'image'`); `image.getJob` is the authoritative state and re-signs every `result.images[].url`. Most apps should use `anna.image.generateAwait()`. Use jobs for 2K/4K or `quality:'high'` renders (60–120 s) that would otherwise hold a sync call open and be lost on reload.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

params.name: prompt
params.summary: Same as the sync method. Provider safety refusals end the job as `failed` with `error.code:'IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED'` — fully refunded.

params.name: n
params.summary: Images in this job (one job = n images, submitted as one provider request `num_images=n`). Capped by `image_grant.maxPerCallGenerate` / `maxPerCallEdit` and the model's `maxN` → `IMAGE_PER_CALL_EXCEEDED`.

params.name: reference_image_urls
params.summary: https URLs (SSRF-checked). Re-hosted by the platform before submit; count is capped by the model's `capabilities.edit.maxReferenceImages` → `APP_INVALID_REQUEST` (no silent truncation). Job view echoes `request.referenceImageCount`, never the URLs.

params.name: size / aspect_ratio / fit / params / model / modelPreferences
params.summary: Identical semantics and validation to the sync method (`fit:'strict'` → `IMAGE_SIZE_UNSUPPORTED`; unknown `params` keys dropped into `ignoredParams`).

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: ≤120 chars; echoed in the job view and filterable in `listJobs`.

params.name: idempotencyKey
params.summary: `^[A-Za-z0-9_\-:.]{1,64}$`. Same key within 24h (same user + App, shared between generateAsync and editAsync) → the existing job with `idempotentReplay:true`, never charged twice.

returns.desc: `estimatedCostCU` is the CU held now (settled to the actual image count on success, refunded on failure). `deadlineAt` = now + 15 min. `idempotentReplay:true` means the key matched an existing job (which may already be terminal — `generateAwait` returns it without polling).

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.image` does not list this method, or the user's `image_grant` is off (`enabled` / `allowGenerate` / `allowEdit`) for this App.

errors.name: APP_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Bad body (`prompt` empty, `n` not a positive int, unsafe / non-https URL, bad `idempotencyKey` / `clientTag`, `IMAGE_JOBS_APP_ENABLED` switched off).

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: Not enough CU for the up-front hold (`estimatedCostCU` = per-image price × `n`). HTTP 429.

errors.name: IMAGE_PER_CALL_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: `n` exceeds `image_grant.maxPerCallGenerate` / `maxPerCallEdit` (`data.allowed.maxN`).

errors.name: IMAGE_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: Unknown / inactive `model` (`data.allowed` lists the catalogue), or the model has no job path.

errors.name: IMAGE_SIZE_UNSUPPORTED
errors.desc: `size` / `aspect_ratio` outside the model's space with `fit:'strict'` (`data.allowed`).

errors.name: IMAGE_OPTION_INVALID
errors.desc: A `params` value violates the model's `capabilities.options` schema (`data.{key, reason, allowed}`).

billing.model: pre-charge on submit (per-image catalogue price × n, same formula as the sync path) → settle on the actual image count → full refund on failed / cancelled / expired / provider rejection

limitations: Rows are kept 30 days for billing; objects 7 days — after that `getJob` still answers but `result.images[].url` is `null`.
Deadline is 15 min (`IMAGE_JOB_MAX_DURATION_SECONDS`); past it the poller marks the job `expired` and refunds.
Models are fal-hosted only (`fal-ai/nano-banana-2`, `openai/gpt-image-2`, `bytedance/seedream/v5/pro/text-to-image`); `capabilities.jobs` in the catalogue tells you jobs are available.
`IMAGE_JOBS_APP_ENABLED=false` (platform switch) rejects new jobs with `APP_INVALID_REQUEST 'image jobs disabled'`; existing jobs stay queryable.

items.name: image.editAsync
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.image_edit_async → input re-host → quota hold → anna_media_jobs INSERT → fal queue edit endpoint → R2
items.summary: Submit an asynchronous edit job (whole-image or mask-based). Body = `image.edit` body + `clientTag?` / `idempotencyKey?`. Requires `image_grant.allowEdit` (default **off**). `image_url` / `mask_url` are SSRF-checked and re-hosted to platform storage before submission, so an expiring input URL cannot break a queued job. Everything else mirrors `image.generateAsync`.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature:
anna.image.editAsync(args: ImageEditArgs & {clientTag?: string, idempotencyKey?: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<ImageJobCreated>

anna.image.editAwait(args, {onProgress?, signal?, timeoutMs?}) => Promise<ImageJobView>

params.name: image_url
params.summary: Base image (https; SSRF-checked). Re-hosted by the platform before submit. Job view echoes `request.hasBaseImage`, not the URL.

params.name: prompt
params.summary: Same as the sync method. Provider safety refusals end the job as `failed` with `error.code:'IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED'` — fully refunded.

params.name: n
params.summary: Images in this job (one job = n images, submitted as one provider request `num_images=n`). Capped by `image_grant.maxPerCallGenerate` / `maxPerCallEdit` and the model's `maxN` → `IMAGE_PER_CALL_EXCEEDED`.

params.name: mask_url
params.summary: 1-channel PNG, same dimensions; only on models with `capabilities.edit.mask` → else `IMAGE_EDIT_MASK_UNSUPPORTED`.

params.name: size / aspect_ratio / fit / params / model / modelPreferences
params.summary: Identical semantics and validation to the sync method (`fit:'strict'` → `IMAGE_SIZE_UNSUPPORTED`; unknown `params` keys dropped into `ignoredParams`).

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: ≤120 chars; echoed in the job view and filterable in `listJobs`.

params.summary: `^[A-Za-z0-9_\-:.]{1,64}$`. Same key within 24h (same user + App, shared between generateAsync and editAsync) → the existing job with `idempotentReplay:true`, never charged twice.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.image` does not list this method, or the user's `image_grant` is off (`enabled` / `allowGenerate` / `allowEdit`) for this App.

errors.name: APP_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Bad body (`prompt` empty, `n` not a positive int, unsafe / non-https URL, bad `idempotencyKey` / `clientTag`, `IMAGE_JOBS_APP_ENABLED` switched off).

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: Not enough CU for the up-front hold (`estimatedCostCU` = per-image price × `n`). HTTP 429.

errors.name: IMAGE_PER_CALL_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: `n` exceeds `image_grant.maxPerCallGenerate` / `maxPerCallEdit` (`data.allowed.maxN`).

errors.name: IMAGE_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: Unknown / inactive `model` (`data.allowed` lists the catalogue), or the model has no job path.

errors.name: IMAGE_SIZE_UNSUPPORTED
errors.desc: `size` / `aspect_ratio` outside the model's space with `fit:'strict'` (`data.allowed`).

errors.name: IMAGE_OPTION_INVALID
errors.desc: A `params` value violates the model's `capabilities.options` schema (`data.{key, reason, allowed}`).

errors.name: IMAGE_EDIT_MASK_UNSUPPORTED
errors.desc: `mask_url` given but the resolved model lacks `capabilities.edit.mask`.

billing.model: pre-charge on submit (per-image catalogue price × n, same formula as the sync path) → settle on the actual image count → full refund on failed / cancelled / expired / provider rejection

limitations: Rows are kept 30 days for billing; objects 7 days — after that `getJob` still answers but `result.images[].url` is `null`.
Deadline is 15 min (`IMAGE_JOB_MAX_DURATION_SECONDS`); past it the poller marks the job `expired` and refunds.
`n` is capped by `maxPerCallEdit` (default 1) and the model's `maxN` (GPT Image 2: 1).

items.name: image.getJob
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.image_get_job → anna_media_jobs (+ R2 presign per image)
items.summary: Authoritative job state. Returns the full `ImageJobView`; on `succeeded`, **each** `result.images[].url` is a freshly presigned R2 GET — calling `getJob` again **re-signs** expired URLs (`null` once the object was garbage-collected after 7 days). `request` echoes counts / flags (`referenceImageCount`, `hasBaseImage`, `hasMask`) instead of the input URLs. `media_job` events are an accelerator; this is the truth.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature:
anna.image.getJob({jobId: string}) => Promise<ImageJobView>

ImageJobView = {jobId, kind:'image', state:'queued'|'running'|'succeeded'|'failed'|'cancelled'|'expired', clientTag?, idempotencyKey?, model, createdAt, updatedAt, deadlineAt, estimatedCostCU, request:{op:'generate'|'edit', prompt, n, size?, aspectRatio?, fit, params, referenceImageCount? | hasBaseImage?, hasMask?, model}, progress?:{seq, phase:'IN_QUEUE'|'IN_PROGRESS', queuePosition?}, result?:{images:[{url: string|null, r2Key, mimeType, width, height, expiresIn}], requestedSize, size, sizeAdjusted, aspectRatio, fit, params, ignoredParams}, billedCostCU?, error?:{code, message}}

params.name: jobId
params.summary: `ijob_…` handle returned by `generateAsync` / `editAsync`.

returns.desc: `result` only on `succeeded`: `images[]` (`url` presigned for `expiresIn` seconds, `r2Key` for `image.resign`, `mimeType`, decoded `width` / `height`), plus the same echo block as the sync path (`requestedSize`, `size`, `sizeAdjusted`, `aspectRatio`, `fit`, `params`, `ignoredParams`). `billedCostCU` is the settled amount (≤ `estimatedCostCU`). On `failed` / `cancelled` / `expired`, `error.code` is `IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED` | `IMAGE_PROVIDER_ERROR` | `IMAGE_JOB_CANCELLED` | `IMAGE_JOB_EXPIRED`.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.image` does not list this method, or the user's `image_grant` is off (`enabled` / `allowGenerate` / `allowEdit`) for this App.

errors.name: IMAGE_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown `jobId`, a `vjob_…` / `mjob_…` handle, or a job owned by another user / App / Executa.

limitations: Rows are kept 30 days for billing; objects 7 days — after that `getJob` still answers but `result.images[].url` is `null`.

items.name: image.cancelJob
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.image_cancel_job → fal queue cancel → anna_media_jobs transition → refund
items.summary: Cancel a job. `queued` → cancelled with a **full refund** (`{jobId, state:'cancelled', refunded:true}`). `running` → the host asks the provider; if it refuses the job keeps rendering to its terminal state and is billed (`{jobId, state:'running', cancelPending:false}`). `generateAwait`'s `signal` abort calls this for you.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.image.cancelJob({jobId: string}) => Promise<{jobId, state:'cancelled', refunded:true} | {jobId, state:'running', cancelPending:false}>

params.name: jobId
params.summary: `ijob_…` handle.

returns.desc: See summary. A concurrent terminal transition (webhook won the race) returns the fresh `ImageJobView` instead.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.image` does not list this method, or the user's `image_grant` is off (`enabled` / `allowGenerate` / `allowEdit`) for this App.

errors.name: IMAGE_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown `jobId`, a `vjob_…` / `mjob_…` handle, or a job owned by another user / App / Executa.

errors.name: IMAGE_JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE

billing.model: refund of the hold when the cancel is accepted

limitations: Running cancels are best-effort — fal only guarantees cancellation while the request is still queued.

items.name: image.listJobs
items.summary: List this App's image jobs for the current user, newest first, cursor-paginated (≤50). Views carry `result.images[].r2Key` but **no presigned URLs** — call `getJob` for a job you want to display. Never returns `vjob_…` / `mjob_…` rows.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.image.listJobs({state?: JobState, clientTag?: string, limit?: number, cursor?: string}) => Promise<{jobs: ImageJobView[], nextCursor: string | null}>

params.name: state
params.summary: Filter by job state.

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: Exact match on the tag you passed at submit.

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.image` does not list this method, or the user's `image_grant` is off (`enabled` / `allowGenerate` / `allowEdit`) for this App.

errors.name: APP_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Malformed `cursor`.

items.example:
const { jobs } = await anna.image.listJobs({ state: 'running' });   // reload recovery
for (const j of jobs) resume(j.jobId);
limitations: Rows are kept 30 days.

items.name: image.resign
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_llm_facade.image_resign → prefix ownership check → R2 presign (no network)
items.summary: Re-sign **already-paid** artifacts by storage key so a user who generated an image can still fetch it after the 30-min URL TTL — up to the 7-day object lifetime. Accepts `images[].r2_key` from a sync `image.generate` / `image.edit` response, `result.images[].r2Key` from a job, and (as a convenience) your own video / music artifact keys. Keys are checked against the caller's own prefixes (`exec-images/{env}/{user_uuid}/…`, `media/{env}/{user_id}/…`); **any** failing key rejects the whole call (`IMAGE_ASSET_NOT_FOUND`, `data.index`) so the App never assumes partial availability. Pure local signing: free, no quota, no existence check — a GC'd object yields a URL that 404s.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/image/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.image.resign({r2Keys: string[]}) => Promise<{urls: {r2Key: string, url: string, expiresIn: number}[]}>

params.name: r2Keys
params.summary: 1–20 keys, each ≤512 chars. Output order = input order.

returns.desc: `expiresIn` is the presign TTL in seconds (1800).

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.image` does not list this method, or the user's `image_grant` is off (`enabled` / `allowGenerate` / `allowEdit`) for this App.

errors.name: APP_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Empty / >20 / non-string / over-long key list.

errors.name: IMAGE_ASSET_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: A key is not under this user's `exec-images/` or `media/` prefix, or is malformed — `data.index` points at it; nothing is signed. HTTP 404.

limitations: Objects are deleted 7 days after creation; a re-signed URL for a deleted object returns 404 — treat as expired.
Only `image_grant.enabled` is required — the method does not distinguish generate / edit.
